🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector participation in cyclicals/defensive staples (Energy, Consumer Staples, Industrials ABOVE TREND) alongside clustered weakness in Big Tech and Financials (MSFT, ADBE, CRM, JPM, V BELOW TREND) — mixed signals warrant caution; Leadership: Broad (Top 5 from 5 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Staples lead: MO (1W: +12.34% | 1M: +6.54%) ABOVE TREND, MDLZ (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: XOM (1W: +9.88% | 1M: +9.58%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +10.86% | 1M: +19.06%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +15.26% | 1M: +19.25%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +6.35% | 1M: +18.71%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -4.98% | 1M: -4.00%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -9.96% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND — Tech: 6/19 positive. Financials weak: JPM (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -2.91%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -5.36%) BELOW TREND — Financials: 4/20 positive. Healthcare soft: UNH (1W: -1.97% | 1M: -2.01%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -7.68% | 1M: +0.82%) TREND EXHAUSTION — Healthcare: 7/15 positive.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: LMT (1W: +15.26% | 1M: +19.25%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +13.95% | 1M: +17.90%) ABOVE TREND, MO (1W: +12.34% | 1M: +6.54%) ABOVE TREND, LOW (1W: +11.26% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors represented) — cyclicals and staples dominating top ranks.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -15.39%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -22.20%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.98% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -9.96% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -7.71%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech and pockets of Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves: LMT (1W: +15.26%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +14.29%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +13.95%) ABOVE TREND, MO (1W: +12.34%) ABOVE TREND, MDLZ (1W: +11.10%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: multiple big names (NVDA, AMZN, C, ISRG, LLY, TSLA) show 1W vs 1M mismatch — treat as transitional/tactical, watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak; marquee names split with GOOGL (1W: +4.30% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND but MSFT (1W: -4.98% | 1M: -4.00%) BELOW TREND and several large caps (ADBE, CRM, INTU, QCOM) BELOW TREND. Tech breadth: 6/19 positive — Rotation away from concentrated Tech leadership into cyclicals.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cautious and soft: JPM (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -2.91%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -7.51% | 1M: -5.36%) BELOW TREND, C (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +0.55%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Financials breadth: 4/20 positive — watch credit/earnings headlines; sector currently showing weakness.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed; defensive JNJ (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +3.29%) ABOVE TREND but pockets of exhaustion (ISRG TREND EXHAUSTION, LLY TREND EXHAUSTION). Healthcare breadth: 7/15 positive — selective names showing strength while others lag.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and staples: Energy (XOM, CVX), Industrials (LMT, CAT), Materials (DOW) given ABOVE TREND performance; reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names that are BELOW TREND (MSFT, ADBE, CRM) and monitor Financials (JPM, V) for further deterioration. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt while treating Tech weakness as a tactical risk given MAJOR divergence.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +9.88% | 1M: +9.58%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +15.26% | 1M: +19.25%) ABOVE TREND — follow earnings/capacity headlines. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -9.96% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -7.71%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -2.91%) BELOW TREND — monitor for follow-through.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (7/8 positive) and Consumer Staples (9/12 positive) for continued leadership; BEARISH: Technology (6/19 positive) and Financials (4/20 positive) for downside risk and headline sensitivity.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (TREND EXHAUSTION): watch failure of the recent 1W bounce for confirmation of further pullback; AAPL (BELOW TREND): monitor breach of recent 1M lows as confirmation of sustained weakness; JPM (BELOW TREND): watch continued 1W underperformance to signal deeper financials rotation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (+55): "sold out 2026 server CPU capacity" — INTC (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming price action. CVX (+50): Venezuela license scoop — CVX (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +11.50%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming. C (+50): Citigroup earnings highlights — C (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +0.55%) TREND EXHAUSTION, sentiment positive but price diverging (watch follow-through).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (-50): Goldman sell rating — ADBE (1W: -9.96% | 1M: -14.59%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirming downside. QCOM (-45): supply concerns headline — QCOM (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -7.71%) BELOW TREND, confirming. COF (-45): policy/credit headlines — COF (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -1.45%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirming; TSLA (-50) shows divergence as POTENTIAL REVERSAL (1W: +1.81% | 1M: -4.31%) — watch sentiment vs price action.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, Value/Cyclical style favored over Growth. XOM (1W: +9.88% | 1M: +9.58%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +15.26% | 1M: +19.25%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +14.29% | 1M: +28.85%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across Big Tech and select Financials (ADBE, MSFT, JPM) with negative sentiment pockets — monitor for trend confirmation before expanding risk.
